read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_1: stprk3_stg.F90:365 opens the stage-1/2 arm selector, IF( ln_dynadv_vec .OR. lk_linssh ). Its TRUE arm at :366-369 advances the velocity directly, ( uu(Kbb) + rDt*uu(Krhs) ) * umask, with no thickness ratios at all. Its ELSE arm at :370-388 is the thickness-weighted one, and under key_qco that is :373-378, the (1+r3u(Kbb))/(1+r3u(Kmm))/(1+r3u(Kaa)) form.
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_2: STAGE 3 IS NOT IN THAT SELECT. stprk3_stg.F90:395 CASE(3) adds the leftover RHS terms and does no time stepping; the stage-3 time integration is inside dyn_zdf, and dynzdf.F90:119 carries THE SAME selector IF( ln_dynadv_vec .OR. lk_linssh ), whose TRUE arm at :121-122 is again ( puu(Kbb) + rDt*puu(Krhs) ) * umask with no ratios, and whose ELSE arm at :124-142 is the thickness-weighted one (:127-132 under key_qco).
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_3: COMPILED, not inferred. GYRE compiles key_qco key_vco_1d3d key_RK3 (cpp_GYRE_OMIP_L2_P3_SM.fcm) so the ELSE arm is the key_qco form, and lk_linssh is .FALSE. in that build's own dom_oce.f90. Its deck resolves ln_dynadv_vec = T (round19_oracle_v2_external/ocean.output:798). So on GYRE, NEMO takes the VECTOR arm at all three stages: stprk3_stg.F90:366-369 at stages 1-2 and dynzdf.F90:121-122 at stage 3, in the compiled ppsrc at GYRE_OMIP_L2_P3_SM/BLD/ppsrc/nemo/dynzdf.f90:138-142.
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_4: THE TANKS TAKE THE OTHER ARM. LOCK resolves ln_dynadv_vec = F (lock_kt1_10/ocean.output:705) and OVERFLOW ln_dynadv_vec = F (overflow_kt1_10/ocean.output:822); both compile key_qco and neither compiles key_linssh, so lk_linssh is .FALSE. in each build's own dom_oce.f90 and both take the key_qco ELSE arm at every stage.
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_5: legoESM ALREADY honours r0_1 at stages 1 and 2. ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:5922 sets _vector_velocity_stage_update from momentum_advection == 'vector_invariant', and :6157 and :6230 branch on it. The STAGE-3 update at :6304-6305 does not: it carries (1+r3u) ratios unconditionally.
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_6: THE DEFECT HAS A COMMENT. ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:5883-5887 says '... Stage 3 still enters dyn_zdf's key_qco solve in either momentum program.' Read against dynzdf.F90:119 that is FALSE: dyn_zdf selects the same way stprk3_stg.F90:365 does. This is a transcription defect and the comment is the wrong belief that produced it.
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_7: GYRE AT kt=1 IS AT REST. The round-29 record's uu_Kbb_in and vv_Kbb_in are identically 0.0 (max |uu_Kbb_in| = 0.0). So at kt=1 both arms reduce to a pure product and their DIFFERENCE is exactly dt*rhs*((1+r3u(Kmm))/(1+r3u(Kaa)) - 1). r3u carries no level index, so that factor is COLUMN-UNIFORM.
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_8: rDt = 14400.0 in the round-29 record; card.dt_s = 14400.0 for GYRE-zco. Round 30 measured legoESM's stage-3 momentum RHS entering dyn_zdf AT-BAR against NEMO's own Krhs: absolute max 2.0614443633579772e-16 on u and 2.482728e-16 on v (round30/round30_post_ldf_after.json).

the_change.claim_under_test: GYRE's remaining dyn_zdf entry residual, 4.5974974126122489e-11 on u and 1.2570099171618776e-10 on v, is owned by legoESM's stage-3 explicit update taking the key_qco thickness-ratio arm where NEMO's compiled deck takes the vector arm at dynzdf.F90:121-122.
the_change.landing_rule: ONE shared program, no knob, no card-specific branch, no second implementation. The SAME selector legoESM already honours at stages 1 and 2 is routed through ONE helper that all three stages call, so stage 3 cannot drift from stages 1-2 again.
statements_changed: a module-level public rk3_stage_velocity_update is added to ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py carrying BOTH arms verbatim -- the vector arm (velocity_before + dt_stage*rhs)*face_mask and the key_qco arm (q_bb*velocity_before + dt_stage*q_mm*rhs)/q_aa -- module-level rather than a closure so a Rule-12 gate can drive it with NEMO's own record arrays.
stages 1, 2 and 3 all call it. Stages 1 and 2 keep byte-identical expressions on both arms; only stage 3 gains the vector arm it was missing.
the false comment at ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:5883-5887 is corrected to what dynzdf.F90:119 says.
not_changed_and_why: the key_qco arm gains NO umask, although NEMO's ELSE arm carries one. legoESM masks after the barotropic correction instead, and that is bit-identical: on a dry face the correction's stage_mask zeroes the value, and the correction's own column mean weights with e3u_0*mask so a dry level contributes nothing either way. Adding the mask would be a second change.
the decision-17 guard in ocean/vertical.py, and the tanks' zdf_baroclinic_only flag: both untouched by instruction.

P1_the_dyn_zdf_entry_residual.instrument: the round-31 walk gate, --mode pre_solve, boundary A_explicit_update, on the round-29 oracle root; BEFORE and AFTER on clean committed trees.
P1_the_dyn_zdf_entry_residual.how_the_point_estimate_was_built: rDt times round 30's measured stage-3 RHS residual (14400 * 2.0614443633579772e-16 and 14400 * 2.482728e-16). Because GYRE is at rest at kt=1 (r0_7), the whole update is a product with dt, so once the ratios are gone the only surviving term is dt times the RHS residual.
P1_the_dyn_zdf_entry_residual.P1a_CONFIRM: u in [2.0e-12, 4.5e-12] AND v in [2.4e-12, 5.4e-12] -- the point estimates with a +/-50 per cent window, because a max of a sum is not the sum of maxes and the RHS residual is re-measured this round.
P1_the_dyn_zdf_entry_residual.P1b_REFUTE: u above 1.0e-11. Then the key_qco ratios are NOT the owner of the entry residual and the fix's premise is wrong.
P1_the_dyn_zdf_entry_residual.P1d_CONSISTENCY_ARM: the round-30 gate --mode post_ldf is re-run on the SAME tree; rDt times its measured RHS residual must reproduce the measured boundary A to within a factor of 2. If it does not, the stage-3 RHS moved and the attribution is not clean -- that disagreement is the finding, and neither number is recorded (Rule 1e).
P1_the_dyn_zdf_entry_residual.P1e_ARITHMETIC_NOT_A_MEASUREMENT: 4.5974974126122489e-11 / 3.7899e-04 = 1.213e-07 is the implied max |(1+r3u(Kmm))/(1+r3u(Kaa)) - 1| on this card. Labelled arithmetic.

P2_the_kt1_stage3_velocity.instrument: the round-31 walk gate, --mode depth_profile, same root, BEFORE and AFTER.
P2_the_kt1_stage3_velocity.P2a_CONFIRM_and_it_is_the_counter_intuit: the peak does NOT fall by an order of magnitude: u stays in [3.0e-13, 4.5e-12] and v in [3.0e-13, 5.5e-12]. WHY, written before measuring: the qco arm difference is c(i,j) times the explicit update ITSELF (r0_7 -- the factor is column-uniform), and stprk3_stg.F90:440,444-445 removes that column's e3u_0-weighted mean, so only c times the BAROCLINIC part of the update survives -- 2.79e-12 out of an entry error of 4.60e-11, i.e. 6.1 per cent. Removing the qco term entirely leaves the dt-times-RHS-roundoff term, about 3e-12 at entry and NOT column-uniform, so the correction removes little of it. The two are the same size; the output need not improve.
P2_the_kt1_stage3_velocity.P2b_REFUTES_P2a: the u peak falls below 3.0e-13. Then the surviving error was not dominated by the RHS roundoff and round 30's RHS number needs re-examining.
P2_the_kt1_stage3_velocity.P2c_ALSO_REFUTES: the u peak rises above 4.5e-12, i.e. the fix makes the stage-3 velocity worse. Under Rule 12 that is a worsened row with a boundary and an owner, not a revert.
P2_the_kt1_stage3_velocity.P2d_the_surface_level: the level-1 error stays within a factor 3 of 1.764547e-12, i.e. in [5.9e-13, 5.3e-12].

P3_the_kt1_to_kt10_trajectory.instrument: nemo_testcase_phase3_trajectory_gate --trajectory-only --max-step 10 on GYRE, all three oracle roots pinned to the V2 root; BEFORE and AFTER on clean committed trees.
P3_the_kt1_to_kt10_trajectory.P3a: the first-over-bar step does NOT move: still kt=2, still on T, S, u and v.
P3_the_kt1_to_kt10_trajectory.P3b: kt2.before.T and kt2.before.S do NOT move by a single bit. Round 32 moved kt=1's stage-3 velocity by 9.5e-07 and neither moved; this round moves it by at most about 3e-12, five orders smaller.
P3_the_kt1_to_kt10_trajectory.P3c_REFUTES_P3b: either T or S moves. That is the finding, and it also means round 32's 'did not move by a single bit' has to be re-read.
P3_the_kt1_to_kt10_trajectory.P3d_the_named_next_candidate_for_T_and_S: if T and S again do not move, their owner is not the stage-3 velocity at all. READ OFF THE CODE, not measured: legoESM's stage-3 tracer step consumes the STAGE-2 transport _g2, built from (u2_corr, v2_corr) at ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:6247-6248, so no change to the stage-3 velocity can reach kt=1's tracers; kt=2's T and S can only inherit through kt=1's FINAL u/v and eta. THE DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT, registered here so the next round does not re-derive it: score kt=1's T and S at stages 1, 2 and 3 against the round-29 root's oracle_rktracer_stage3_kt00000001.bin and the round-21 stage records, and report the FIRST stage over bar. A stage-1 or stage-2 failure exonerates everything downstream of it.
P3_the_kt1_to_kt10_trajectory.P3e_worsened_rows: a row is WORSENED when normalized_max_abs is larger after than before; ABOVE ROUNDOFF when the relative increase exceeds 1e-6. Every worsened row is registered with its boundary and its owner, UNKNOWN allowed and written as such. Rule 12: never a revert.

GYRE-zco.discharge: a new rule12_stage_update mode on the round-31 walk gate -- which already owns nemo_explicit_update, the exact oracle side of this operator, and read_zdf_matrix -- drives legoESM's own rk3_stage_velocity_update with the record's uu_Kbb_in, uu_Krhs_in, rDt and umask.
GYRE-zco.P4a_CONFIRM: BIT FOR BIT, exact = true and n_unequal = 0, not merely at the 1e-15 bar. The expression is one multiply, one add and one multiply on identical operands in identical association order, so anything less is a transcription defect.
GYRE-zco.P4a_REFUTE: any unequal cell inside the writer's tile on the wet mask.

LOCK_EXCHANGE-zco_and_OVERFLOW-zps.P4b_CONFIRM: the kt=1..10 trajectory on each tank is BIT-IDENTICAL before and after: every one of the 50 rows unchanged and the residual arrays bit-equal.
LOCK_EXCHANGE-zco_and_OVERFLOW-zps.P4b_REFUTE: any bit moves. Then the refactor is not the no-op it claims to be on the qco arm, and that is a defect in the extraction rather than in the physics.
